name: Covid19_Benchmark_Dataset
description: A compiled collection of COVID-19–related textual data (e.g., tweets, reports, or scientific text) intended to support downstream NLP tasks such as classification, entity extraction, and information retrieval for pandemic-related research. The benchmark is used to evaluate models on tasks like sentiment/stance classification, named entity recognition, and topic/information retrieval in the COVID-19 domain.
reputation: A domain-specific dataset used in COVID-19 NLP research with moderate adoption among pandemic-related NLP studies but not a broadly standardized benchmark.
